question: Can a minimal opt-in precision patch for the open TRL GRPO KL-log-ratio clip reject unrepresentable half-precision caps and preserve the bias-corrected corrective gradient without changing the float32 or unclipped path?
patch_contract: When clipping is enabled, reject a positive cap that becomes zero or non-finite after conversion to the original KL-log-ratio dtype.
For float16 or bfloat16 clipping, evaluate the clipped K3 path and bias-correction product in float32.
When bias correction is enabled, preserve the analytically combined gradient for the clipped KL term instead of relying on two large low-precision branches to cancel.
When clipping is unset or the original log-ratio dtype is float32, preserve the existing candidate code path.

estimands.bias_corrected_gradient: for r=exp(log(pi_theta/pi_old)) and a straight-through upper cap, d[r*F(min(x,c))]/d(log pi_theta) = -r*min(x,c); multiply by beta=0.1
estimands.fixture: one completion token, x=20, log(pi_theta)=log(pi_old)=0, r=1, zero advantage

frozen_cases.name: tiny_float16_cap
frozen_cases.expected: raise a clear ValueError before silently returning zero KL and zero gradient

frozen_cases.name: representable_float16_cap_without_bias_correction
frozen_cases.expected: finite positive KL/loss, finite negative gradient; output and gradient remain within 1e-3 relative tolerance of unmodified PR head

frozen_cases.name: representable_float16_cap_with_default_bias_correction
frozen_cases.expected: finite positive KL/loss and gradient -1.0 within absolute tolerance 0.05

frozen_cases.name: representable_float32_control
frozen_cases.expected: bit-identical loss and gradient to unmodified PR head

frozen_cases.name: unclipped_float32_control
frozen_cases.expected: bit-identical loss and gradient to unmodified PR head

method: Invoke the actual GRPOTrainer._compute_loss method from the unmodified PR head and a single-file patched copy using a differentiable one-token fixture. No model, dataset, trainer initialization, optimizer, or external service is used. Independently compare recorded outputs and source identities using a checker that does not import TRL.
failure_criteria: the source base/head revisions differ from the frozen revisions
the proposed patch changes paths outside the frozen trainer file
the patched loss method cannot be imported and directly executed
the tiny cap returns a finite zero penalty instead of failing closed
the float16 corrected gradient is zero, positive, non-finite, or outside the frozen tolerance
the float32 or unclipped control changes from the unmodified PR head
interpretation_limits: Passing this fixture validates only the numerical method edge and does not establish behavior prevalence in model training.
No real model update, optimizer effect, task outcome, Liger kernel, GPU, or external reproduction is covered.
The patch is a VARE-side review candidate, not an upstream fix or PR until maintainers accept it.
